name: Droidforge
description: Automate every repetitive Android dev task — keystore creation, signing config, version bumping, Gradle version catalog management, new app scaffolding, and Play Store release checklists. Run /droidforge:setup once per project. All commands read your saved config automatically — no repeated questions, no hardcoded values.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **3 agents** and **7 commands**.

- **Skills** (5): `gradle-best-practices` (Gradle Kotlin DSL and version catalog best practices for Android projects in 2025-2026 — covers TOML version catalog,…), `keystore-conventions` (Android keystore generation standards for DroidForge users — RSA 2048, 10000-day validity, consistent alias and password conventions), `multi-app-structure` (Managing a portfolio of 20+ Android apps as a solo developer — repo strategy, shared code, keystore management,…), `package-naming` (Android package naming conventions for DroidForge users — format rules, portfolio consistency, privacy policy URL patterns, and GitHub…), `release-workflow` (End-to-end Android app release workflow for solo developers — pre-release steps, build commands, ADB install testing, Play Console…)
- **Agents** (3): `gradle-agent` (Gradle dependency and version catalog management agent), `release-agent` (Android release preparation agent — handles version bumping, git tagging, changelog generation, and release notes), `setup-agent` (Scaffolds complete, production-ready Android projects following the developer's saved DroidForge conventions)
- **Commands** (7): `gradle-update` (Update dependencies in an Android project's Gradle version catalog (libs.versions.toml)), `keystore` (Generate a new keystore for an Android app using your saved DroidForge conventions), `new-app` (Scaffold a complete new Android app following your saved DroidForge conventions), `release-checklist` (Run a pre-release checklist before submitting an Android app to Google Play), `setup` (One-time DroidForge setup — saves your Android developer conventions to .claude-plugin-config.json so all commands work without repeated questions), `signing-config` (Generate the signing configuration block for an Android app's build.gradle.kts), `version-bump` (Bump versionCode and versionName in an Android app's build.gradle.kts)

Installs with `claude plugin install droidforge@claude-community` from `SUDARSHANCHAUDHARI/DroidForge`.
